properties.name: ssgkimchi:inventory:scope
properties.value: Conservative package-lock production closure (required, optional, installed peers) plus the shipped Electron runtime and selected non-npm runtime assets.

properties.name: ssgkimchi:inventory:scope-limitation:chromium
properties.value: Chromium internal components are not expanded; consult the hashed Electron LICENSES.chromium.html notice.

properties.name: ssgkimchi:inventory:scope-limitation:rhwp-wasm
properties.value: Rust crates compiled into @rhwp/core WASM are not enumerated by npm metadata; obtain a version-bound upstream crate inventory.

properties.name: ssgkimchi:inventory:scope-limitation:artifact
properties.value: Declared optional dependencies may be overincluded and declared production dependencies may be bundled rather than copied as node_modules; this is not a byte-level installer inventory.

properties.name: ssgkimchi:inventory:scope-limitation
properties.value: Chromium and its internal third-party components are not expanded into npm components; the Electron runtime notice is authoritative.

license.name: See @rhwp/core and embedded Rust crate scope limitation

properties.name: ssgkimchi:inventory:scope-limitation
properties.value: The npm lockfile identifies @rhwp/core but does not enumerate Rust crates compiled into the WASM. The local package has no crate-level THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES file.
